# source: fancyhdr manual §2 (\fancyhead/\fancyfoot/\fancyhf and the
# \lhead...\rfoot shorthands), §7 (\fancypagestyle), §5 (\headrulewidth).
# Two rows move no ink and say why: \fancyhf{} outside the fancy style clears
# to the state a document starts in, and \renewcommand{\headrulewidth} binds
# the width \pagestyle{fancy} reads for the rule under the head.
pre impl \pagestyle{fancy}
pre impl \fancyhead[L]{x}
pre impl \fancyfoot[C]{x}
pre inert:default \fancyhf{}
pre refuse:W0301 \fancypagestyle{mine}{\fancyhead[L]{x}}
pre impl \lhead{x}
pre impl \chead{x}
pre impl \rhead{x}
pre impl \lfoot{x}
pre impl \cfoot{x}
pre impl \rfoot{x}
pre inert:binds \renewcommand{\headrulewidth}{0pt}
